## Midterm 2

Monday, November 9, in class, 60 minutes. The exam covers Lectures 15 to 20.

The exam has two parts, weighted equally at 10 points each: ten multiple-choice questions and one long-form question. Each part is its own sheet, printed front and back. **Write your name and your CWID, one digit per box, at the top of every sheet.** The exam is closed book and closed notes. Bring a basic calculator. There is no help sheet, since there is not much to put on one: the only formulas you might need are for the area of a triangle or a rectangle, and any question that needs one will give it.

-   [Module IV notes (PDF)](notes/module4/notes-module4.pdf): nearly everything you need for this exam, organized by concept.
-   [Study guide (PDF)](exams/midterm2/midterm2-study-guide.pdf): how to prepare, and what you should know.
-   [Practice Exam A (PDF)](exams/midterm2/midterm2-practice-a.pdf), with [solutions (PDF)](exams/midterm2/midterm2-practice-a-solutions.pdf).
-   [Practice Exam B (PDF)](exams/midterm2/midterm2-practice-b.pdf), with [solutions (PDF)](exams/midterm2/midterm2-practice-b-solutions.pdf).

Take the practice exams timed, with no notes, then check your answers against the solutions.

## Midterm 1

Monday, October 12, in class, 65 minutes. The exam covers Lectures 3 to 13.

The exam has three parts, weighted equally: multiple-choice questions, short-answer problems, and one long-form question. Each part is its own sheet, printed front and back. **Write your name and your CWID, one digit per box, at the top of every sheet.** Closed book and closed notes; bring a basic calculator.

-   [Study guide (PDF)](exams/midterm1/midterm1-study-guide.pdf): work through it topic by topic. You can use it on screen or print it.
-   [Practice exam (PDF)](exams/midterm1/midterm1-practice.pdf), with [solutions (PDF)](exams/midterm1/midterm1-practice-solutions.pdf): the same format as the real exam. Take it timed, with only the help sheet, then check your answers.
-   [Help sheet (PDF)](exams/midterm1/midterm1-help-sheet.pdf): the sheet you will be given with the exam, so you know what to expect. You do not need to print it.
